topics.title: Describe Noelle in three words
topics.answer: Adaptable. Proactive. Empathetic. Would you like a few examples of how Noelle demonstrates these traits?
topics.examplesAnswer:
Adaptable: Noelle has supported SaaS products across HR, digital banking, and marketing technology. She joined the support queue in just two weeks instead of the planned four by proactively studying past tickets, product documentation, and team discussions. At Sequoia, she also taught herself SQL in two months so she could investigate customer data issues more independently.

Proactive: At Sequoia, Noelle noticed a pattern of clients reporting login issues around the beginning of the year. Rather than treating each ticket as an isolated access problem, she used SQL to audit affected accounts and discovered their access end dates were set to December 31. That meant access would expire as soon as the clock struck midnight on January 1. The vendor's updated files typically arrived about two weeks into the new year, leaving a gap before those accounts could be refreshed. Noelle brought her findings to the Analysts and Client team and collaborated with them on getting the vendor to deliver files earlier. The solution required roughly two months of cross-team work to build the infrastructure for earlier file intake. The lasting fix prevented recurring New Year login disruptions and helped rebuild clients' trust in the product.

Empathetic: When a Shopify integration stopped sending order confirmations to Extole, Noelle understood how frustrating it was for the client when customers weren't receiving referral rewards. Rather than simply saying the issue had been escalated, she explained what the investigation had confirmed, proposed manual referral credits as a temporary workaround, and committed to updates every 48 hours while Engineering investigated. By acknowledging the impact, offering a practical next step, and following through on communication, she helped de-escalate a difficult situation and maintain the client's confidence.
